subject: Acme Corp - MAP: Technical evaluation plan (latency / cost targets)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme - MAP: Technical evaluation plan (latency / cost targets)

Hi Daniel / Olivia —

Great to meet you both on the call today. Per our discussion, attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone focused on the Technical Evaluation so we can align on success criteria, owners, timeline, and dependencies. Key asks from your side are noted below.

Quick recap / proposed milestones (draft):
- Kickoff & baseline data (owner: Acme) — provide sample traffic, p95 latency targets, and cost budget by 6/19
- Test infra & data access (owner: Redwood SE + Acme infra) — setup sandbox VPC and sample dataset by 6/24
- Benchmarks & shortlisting (owner: Redwood SE) — run generation/embedding benchmarks across shortlisted models by 7/2
- Quality evaluation (owner: Acme/R&D + Redwood) — run sample prompts, human evals, success metrics by 7/9
- Final recommendation & SLA impact (owner: Redwood + Acme Eng) — agree on deployment model and target close by 7/16

Success criteria (draft):
- Latency: p95 generation latency <= 250ms for 512-token responses (target 200ms)
- Cost: inference unit cost <= $1.20 per 1k tokens for production profile (or show tradeoffs)
- Quality: automated pass rate >= 90% on the provided prompt set; no critical hallucination cases in top-10
- Scalability: linear throughput to 20 concurrent streams without >20% p95 degradation

Model shortlist (initial):
- llama-3-13b-instruct (quantized)
- mistral-7b-instruct
- redwood-instruct-34b (fp16)

Dependencies / blockers:
- Access to an anonymized sample of production traffic (Daniel)
- Network connectivity for sandbox GPUs (Olivia / Acme infra)
- Signed NDA for deeper logs if needed (Procurement)

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), latency_benchmark_spec.pdf (benchmark plan)

Next steps:
1) Daniel — confirm sample dataset and whether we can get a 48-hour window of traffic by Friday (6/19)
2) Olive — confirm sandbox VPC contact and attach network allowlist steps
3) Camila — I’ve looped you as SE to own the bench runs; can you confirm resource ETA?

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP file in Drive once we get confirmations.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]
[Attachment: latency_benchmark_spec.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme - MAP: Technical evaluation plan (latency / cost targets)

Thanks Marissa — adding a few notes from the SE perspective and some practical benchmark targets we usually measure.

SE notes / measurement plan:
- Benchmarks we will run: cold-start generation (single request), warmed KV cache generation (simulating conversation), embeddings throughput
- Metrics collected: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, memory/kv cache hit rates, tokens-per-dollar (using Redwood cost model)
- Target latency bands for bench runs: p95 <= 250ms (target 200ms) for 512 tokens; p50 target <= 60ms
- Cost modeling: we will provide a token-cost breakdown for each model variant and quantization option (int8 vs fp16)

Provisional resource plan:
- I can start bench runs 6/25 once sandbox VPC and sample data are in place. Will need 1 x A100-equivalent for 24–48 hours per model flavor.

Model shortlist suggestion (expanded):
- mistral-7b-instruct (fast, lower cost)
- llama-3-13b-instruct (midline quality/latency)
- redwood-instruct-34b (higher quality, higher cost)
- vicuna-13b-q4 (quantized option if they need lower cost)

I'll prepare a simple benchmark script and share results as a single CSV + perf dashboard. cc: @Lauren for visibility on timeline alignment.

-Camila
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Inline: camila-se-bench-plan.sh (text)]

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme - MAP: Technical evaluation plan (latency / cost targets)

Thanks Marissa/Camila — this looks good and aligns with what Eng asked for. A couple quick items:

1) Sample data: we can provide a 2-day anonymized traffic dump. I’ll aim to share S3 access by EOD Friday (6/19).
2) Sandbox VPC: Olivia is looping in our infra team; she will send allowlist IPs and a contact for VPN setup.
3) NDA: procurement@acme.com — I’ve asked them to expedite the minimal NDA for log-level review, target sign by 6/22.

A couple of clarifying Qs for the bench:
- For the 512-token p95 target, is that single-request generation or typical multi-turn scenario (we expect multi-turn to raise latency)?
- Can you advise on what "tokens-per-dollar" assumptions Redwood will use for the cost model?

Also, can we shift the bench start to 6/26? Olivia indicated infra team availability on that date.

Thanks,
Daniel
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp

- Tokens-per-dollar: Camila will provide Redwood's cost assumptions (GPU hourly + model throughput) and a tokens-per-dollar table per model/quantization.
